personality_one_liner: A warm, trustworthy safe space for parents, and a playful, chunky, colorful playground for kids.

spacing.rule: Generous touch targets for kids (min 56pt), calm breathing room for parents. Consistent margins.

dont's: Kids interactive game grid cards (keep them solid and chunky)

screens.name: Onboarding & Auth
screens.purpose: Guide parents through account creation and explain the dual-mode nature of the app.

states.error: Toast with readable message and Retry.

screens.layout: Large hero illustration (parent & child), clear value proposition in Fredoka. Google Login and Email buttons stacked at the bottom (thumb zone). Generous spacing, warm background (surface).

screens.name: Profile Switcher
screens.purpose: Allow users to enter Parent Mode or Kid Mode securely.
screens.layout: Two massive, touchable cards filling the horizontal space with space-between. Left card: 'Parent' with calm icon. Right card: 'Kid' with 3D cute face mascot. Chunky borders, shadow 2.

screens.name: Parent Home Feed
screens.purpose: Display daily emotional guidance videos for parents.

states.empty: Illustration of a calm plant + 'No new videos today. Check back tomorrow!'

screens.layout: Single column vertical scroll. Video cards at 100% width minus padding. Each card has a cover image (parent talking with child), vertical gradient scrim, title, and play icon. Glass header pinned at top.

screens.name: Kids Games Hub
screens.purpose: Interactive portal for kids to access their 5 emotional learning games.
screens.layout: Playful, controlled asymmetry. 2-col grid wrapping games (Mood Match, Calm Breathing, Story Builder, Kindness Quest, Emotion Memory Cards). Vivid, saturated card backgrounds using BrandSecondary and BrandTertiary. Oversized game icons, rounded pill shapes.

screens.name: Video Player & Paywall
screens.purpose: Play emotional guidance content and lock premium ones behind Razorpay.
screens.layout: Video fills top half. Bottom half has description, related videos. If premium: Blur overlay on bottom half with 'Unlock Premium' CTA sticky at bottom. Trust-building typography.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: Allow admins to securely upload new guidance videos via URL or file.

states.empty: No videos uploaded yet. Tap '+' to start.

screens.layout: Utilitarian but friendly. List of uploaded videos with status chips. Fixed FAB (glass over BrandPrimary) in bottom right to open upload sheet. Forms use labels above inputs.

auth_hero.alt: Father and son looking at each other happily on the floor

parent_video_thumbnail.alt: Grandfather and grandson lying on the floor talking

kids_memory_game_card.alt: Group of children playing a card game

kid_profile_mascot.alt: Cute 3D emotional face for kids mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a split-mode navigation structure (ParentNav vs KidNav) activated after login. A multi-child account switcher or parent gate should separate them.
Parent Mode must feel trustworthy, spacious, and analytical. Use Nunito primarily. Focus on calm colors (Mint, Sand, Oat).
Kid Mode must feel highly engaging, chunky, and tactile. Use Fredoka. Emphasize large touch targets, saturated accents (BrandPrimary, BrandSecondary), and 3D/Illustration visual weight.
Paywall must sit in the Parent domain. Ensure the Razorpay integration looks secure, utilizing clear typography and subtle glassmorphism to blur locked video content.
On video cards with text over images, absolutely mandate a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to ≥70% surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG AA readability for overlaid text.
Ensure strict adherence to safe area contexts and keyboard-avoiding views, especially in the Admin dashboard form and Onboarding screens.
No emojis anywhere in the system UI. Use Phosphor icons consistently.
No indigo, purple, or navy blues. Rely on the defined warm Terracotta, Oat, Mint, and Charcoal palette.
